Container.Name: hopwatch-hub
Container.Overview: Hopwatch Hub shows several Hopwatch Probes on one page: which problems several sites see at the same moment (the target's side), and which only one site sees (that site's path or its own uplink). It runs MTR from all sites at once, compares charts across sites and builds one evidence pack for a support ticket. The probes keep their own history; the hub reads it with an API token per probe.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the hub web UI.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Settings and the probe tokens (a few KB).

Config.Name: Reset admin password
Config.Description: true removes the admin password at the next start, so you can set a new one in the web UI. Switch it back to false afterwards.
